## 12.2 Mediation models M1–M5 (Prereg §9.2)

```{r mediation-models}
# Center condition (effect coding)
df_primary <- df_primary %>%
  mutate(cond_e = ifelse(condition_label == "HighA", 0.5, -0.5))

# Build datasets that exclude rows missing any variable in the model
build_med_data <- function(dv_set) {
  df_primary %>% select(cond_e, all_of(dv_set)) %>% na.omit()
}

run_mediation <- function(model_syntax, data, model_name) {
  set.seed(42)
  fit <- tryCatch(
    sem(model_syntax, data = data, se = "bootstrap", bootstrap = 5000,  # FIX 2026-09-30 (R4-R1)
        iseed = 42),  # FIX 2026-09-30 (R4-R1): lavaan's own bootstrap seed (lavaan 0.6.21 supports iseed)
    error = function(e) {
      message(glue("Model {model_name} failed: {e$message}"))
      NULL
    }
  )
  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
  pe <- parameterEstimates(fit, ci = TRUE, level = 0.95, boot.ci.type = "bca.simple") %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(model = model_name)
  list(fit = fit, params = pe)
}

# M1: parallel relational mediators of Corporate Liability
m1_syntax <- '
  # Direct effect
  liab_corp ~ c*cond_e
  # Mediators
  psr_total ~ a1*cond_e
  ec_total ~ a2*cond_e
  trust_total ~ a3*cond_e
  liab_corp ~ b1*psr_total + b2*ec_total + b3*trust_total
  # Indirect effects
  ind_psr := a1 * b1
  ind_ec := a2 * b2
  ind_trust := a3 * b3
  total_indirect := ind_psr + ind_ec + ind_trust
  total := c + total_indirect
'
M1 <- run_mediation(m1_syntax,
                    build_med_data(c("liab_corp", "psr_total", "ec_total", "trust_total")),
                    "M1: Relational → Corp")

# M2: parallel mind mediators
m2_syntax <- '
  liab_corp ~ c*cond_e
  ma_total ~ a1*cond_e
  mp_total ~ a2*cond_e
  liab_corp ~ b1*ma_total + b2*mp_total
  ind_ma := a1 * b1
  ind_mp := a2 * b2
  total_indirect := ind_ma + ind_mp
  total := c + total_indirect
'
M2 <- run_mediation(m2_syntax,
                    build_med_data(c("liab_corp", "ma_total", "mp_total")),
                    "M2: Mind → Corp")

# M3: serial litigation theory
m3_syntax <- '
  psr_total ~ a1*cond_e
  mp_total ~ a2*cond_e + d*psr_total
  liab_corp ~ c*cond_e + b1*psr_total + b2*mp_total
  ind_serial := a1 * d * b2
  ind_psr_only := a1 * b1
  ind_mp_only := a2 * b2
  total_indirect := ind_serial + ind_psr_only + ind_mp_only
'
M3 <- run_mediation(m3_syntax,
                    build_med_data(c("liab_corp", "psr_total", "mp_total")),
                    "M3: Serial PSR→MP→Corp")

# M4: PSR → User responsibility
m4_syntax <- '
  psr_total ~ a*cond_e
  liab_user ~ c*cond_e + b*psr_total
  ind := a * b
  total := c + ind
'
M4 <- run_mediation(m4_syntax,
                    build_med_data(c("liab_user", "psr_total")),
                    "M4: PSR → User Resp")

# M5: ET → Corp
m5_syntax <- '
  et_total ~ a*cond_e
  liab_corp ~ c*cond_e + b*et_total
  ind := a * b
  total := c + ind
'
M5 <- run_mediation(m5_syntax,
                    build_med_data(c("liab_corp", "et_total")),
                    "M5: ET → Corp")

# Combine indirect-effect estimates
mediation_indirects <- bind_rows(
  M1$params %>% filter(label %in% c("ind_psr", "ind_ec", "ind_trust", "total_indirect", "c", "total")),
  M2$params %>% filter(label %in% c("ind_ma", "ind_mp", "total_indirect", "c", "total")),
  M3$params %>% filter(label %in% c("ind_serial", "ind_psr_only", "ind_mp_only", "total_indirect")),
  M4$params %>% filter(label %in% c("ind", "c", "total")),
  M5$params %>% filter(label %in% c("ind", "c", "total"))
) %>%
  mutate(supported = ifelse(ci.lower * ci.upper > 0 & label %in%
                            c("ind_psr","ind_ec","ind_trust","ind_ma","ind_mp",
                              "ind_serial","ind_psr_only","ind_mp_only","ind","total_indirect"),
                            "✓ CI excludes 0", "—"))

mediation_indirects %>%
  select(model, label, est, se, z, pvalue, ci.lower, ci.upper, supported) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3)),
         pvalue = fmt_p(pvalue)) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Mediation: indirect effects across M1–M5 (bias-corrected 95% CI from 5000 bootstraps)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)

save_table(mediation_indirects, "14_mediation_indirects")
```

### 12.2.1 Mediation interpretation for Models 1 and 3

The mediation models test whether the condition effect on Corporate Liability operates through the bonding DVs (M1) or through the serial PSR → Moral Patiency path (M3). Two quantities frame these results (live values from §6.1): <!-- FIX 2026-09-30 (C5): stale "d = 0.73" / "essentially zero" / "large and credible" literals replaced by live values -->

- The total effect of condition on Corporate Liability: *d* = `r sprintf("%.2f", results_primary$d[results_primary$dv == "liab_corp"])` [`r sprintf("%.2f", results_primary$d_lo[results_primary$dv == "liab_corp"])`, `r sprintf("%.2f", results_primary$d_hi[results_primary$dv == "liab_corp"])`], *p* = `r fmt_p(results_primary$p[results_primary$dv == "liab_corp"])`, BF₁₀ = `r fmt_bf(results_primary$bf10[results_primary$dv == "liab_corp"])`. <!-- FIX 2026-09-30 (C5) -->
- The condition effect on PSR: *d* = `r sprintf("%.2f", results_primary$d[results_primary$dv == "psr_total"])` [`r sprintf("%.2f", results_primary$d_lo[results_primary$dv == "psr_total"])`, `r sprintf("%.2f", results_primary$d_hi[results_primary$dv == "psr_total"])`], *p* = `r fmt_p(results_primary$p[results_primary$dv == "psr_total"])`, BF₁₀ = `r fmt_bf(results_primary$bf10[results_primary$dv == "psr_total"])`. <!-- FIX 2026-09-30 (C5) -->

The question for mediation is whether the bonding measures carry the condition effect into a downstream effect on liability. The chunk below pulls the actual indirect estimates for explicit reading. <!-- FIX 2026-09-30 (C5): removed "large" classification -->


## 12.3 Dose-response within condition (Prereg §9.3)

```{r dose-response}
dose_response <- map_dfr(confirmatory_dvs, function(dv) {
  map_dfr(c("LowA", "HighA"), function(cond) {
    sub <- df_primary %>% filter(condition_label == cond,
                                  !is.na(.data[[dv]]), !is.na(tipi_bot_agree))
    if (nrow(sub) < 5) return(NULL)
    f <- as.formula(glue("{dv} ~ tipi_bot_agree"))
    m <- lm(f, data = sub)
    cf <- broom::tidy(m, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
      filter(term == "tipi_bot_agree")
    tibble(dv = dv, dv_label = dv_labels[dv], condition = cond,
           slope = cf$estimate, se = cf$std.error,
           p = cf$p.value, ci_lo = cf$conf.low, ci_hi = cf$conf.high,
           R2 = summary(m)$r.squared, n = nrow(sub))
  })
})

dose_response %>%
  arrange(dv_label, condition) %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3)),
         p = fmt_p(p)) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Dose-response: regression of each DV on TIPI-Bot Agreeableness, within each condition") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)

save_table(dose_response, "15_dose_response")
```

## 12.4 Temporal and cohort analyses (Prereg §9.4)

```{r temporal}
# Enrollment order: cb_slot
enrollment_corr <- map_dfr(confirmatory_dvs, function(dv) {
  d_sub <- df_primary %>% filter(!is.na(cb_slot), !is.na(.data[[dv]]))
  if (nrow(d_sub) < 10) return(NULL)
  ct <- cor.test(d_sub$cb_slot, d_sub[[dv]])
  tibble(dv = dv, dv_label = dv_labels[dv], r = ct$estimate, p = ct$p.value)
})

enrollment_corr %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3)),
         p = fmt_p(p)) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Enrollment-order correlations (cb_slot)") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)

# Time of day
df_primary <- df_primary %>%
  mutate(chat_hour = hour(ymd_hms(chat_start_time, quiet = TRUE)),
         time_band = case_when(
           chat_hour >= 6 & chat_hour < 12 ~ "Morning",
           chat_hour >= 12 & chat_hour < 18 ~ "Afternoon",
           chat_hour >= 18 & chat_hour < 24 ~ "Evening",
           TRUE ~ "Late night"
         ),
         day_of_week = wday(ymd_hms(start_time, quiet = TRUE), label = TRUE))

df_primary %>%
  count(time_band, condition_label) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = condition_label, values_from = n, values_fill = 0) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Conversation time of day by condition") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)

save_table(enrollment_corr, "16_enrollment_correlations")
```

## 12.6 Convergent validity (Prereg §9.9)

The prereg specifies convergent validity for the manipulation, not for the bonding scales: the TIPI-Bot subscale for the manipulated trait, the corresponding single-item manipulation check, and an NLP-derived behavioral index of the manipulated trait should converge within condition. We implement the first two within-condition correlations here and leave a placeholder for the NLP-derived behavioral index (added when the NLP coding output is available). We additionally retain the original self-report-bonding × behavioral-indices correlation matrix as exploratory because it speaks to a different construct (whether felt bonding maps onto behavior).

```{r convergent-validity}
# (a) Prereg-specified: TIPI-Bot Agreeableness × mc_agreeableness within each condition
conv_manip <- df_primary %>%
  filter(!is.na(tipi_bot_agree), !is.na(mc_agreeableness_score)) %>%
  group_by(condition_label) %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    r_tipi_mc = cor(tipi_bot_agree, mc_agreeableness_score, use = "pairwise.complete.obs"),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

conv_manip %>%
  mutate(r_tipi_mc = round(r_tipi_mc, 3)) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Manipulation convergent validity within condition: TIPI-Bot Agreeableness × single-item warmth/support check") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)

# Pooled across conditions for completeness
r_pooled <- cor(df_primary$tipi_bot_agree, df_primary$mc_agreeableness_score,
                use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
cat(glue::glue(
  "Pooled across conditions: r(TIPI-Bot A, mc_agreeableness) = {round(r_pooled, 3)}.\n",
  "An NLP-derived behavioral agreeableness index (from chat_log per-turn warmth coding) ",
  "will be added to this matrix when the NLP coding output is available — see Section 10.1 ",
  "of the preregistration. The current placeholder reflects two of the three convergent-validity ",
  "indicators specified in §9.9.\n"
))

# (b) Exploratory: self-report bonding × behavior — retained from earlier draft
conv <- df_primary %>%
  select(psr_total, ec_total, trust_total, et_total,
         user_chars_per_turn, user_total_chars, chat_total_rounds, chat_idle_pause_count) %>%
  cor(use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
conv %>%
  round(2) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Exploratory: self-report bonding scales × behavioral indices") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)

save_table(conv_manip, "17_convergent_validity_manipulation")
save_table(as.data.frame(conv), "17b_convergent_validity_self_report_x_behavior")
```

## 12.8 Response quality indices (Prereg §9.8)

The prereg specifies two response-quality indices computed from the TIPI-Self battery: (a) within-person variance across reverse-scored vs. forward-scored items (low variance suggests careless straight-lining), and (b) Mahalanobis distance on TIPI-Self responses (multivariate outlier detection). Both are examined as moderators of the confirmed bonding effects (do effects differ between high-quality and low-quality responders?) and as a sensitivity-sample exclusion (high-quality only).

```{r response-quality}
# (a) Within-person reverse/forward variance
# TIPI-Self forward items: 1, 3, 5, 7, 9; reverse items: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10
forward_items <- paste0("tipi_self_", c(1, 3, 5, 7, 9))
reverse_items <- paste0("tipi_self_", c(2, 4, 6, 8, 10))

# Re-key reverse items so a careful responder's reverse and forward should have similar means
df_primary <- df_primary %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    tipi_forward_mean   = mean(c_across(all_of(forward_items)), na.rm = TRUE),
    tipi_reverse_unkey  = mean(c_across(all_of(reverse_items)), na.rm = TRUE),
    tipi_reverse_keyed  = 8 - tipi_reverse_unkey,
    tipi_fwd_rev_diff   = abs(tipi_forward_mean - tipi_reverse_keyed),
    # Within-person SD across all 10 items (after re-keying reverse items)
    tipi_within_sd      = sd(c(c_across(all_of(forward_items)),
                               sapply(c_across(all_of(reverse_items)), function(x) 8 - x)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# (b) Mahalanobis distance on TIPI-Self (10 items, rekeyed)
tipi_matrix <- df_primary %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(reverse_items), ~ 8 - .x, .names = "{.col}_keyed")) %>%
  select(all_of(forward_items),
         tipi_self_2_keyed, tipi_self_4_keyed, tipi_self_6_keyed,
         tipi_self_8_keyed, tipi_self_10_keyed) %>%
  as.matrix()

# Drop rows with any NA for Mahalanobis
complete_rows <- complete.cases(tipi_matrix)
mahal <- rep(NA_real_, nrow(df_primary))
if (sum(complete_rows) > 12) {  # need at least p+2 observations
  m_center <- colMeans(tipi_matrix[complete_rows, ])
  m_cov    <- cov(tipi_matrix[complete_rows, ])
  mahal[complete_rows] <- mahalanobis(tipi_matrix[complete_rows, ], m_center, m_cov)
}
df_primary$tipi_mahal <- mahal

# Descriptives
quality_desc <- df_primary %>%
  summarize(
    n = n(),
    `mean fwd-rev abs diff` = round(mean(tipi_fwd_rev_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `mean within-person SD` = round(mean(tipi_within_sd, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `min within-person SD`  = round(min(tipi_within_sd, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    `n with within-SD < 0.5 (potential straight-lining)` = sum(tipi_within_sd < 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    `mean Mahalanobis`      = round(mean(tipi_mahal, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
    `n with Mahalanobis > chi2(.001, df=10)` =
       sum(tipi_mahal > qchisq(0.999, df = 10), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "Statistic", values_to = "Value")

quality_desc %>%
  kbl(caption = "Response-quality descriptives on TIPI-Self battery") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)

# (c) Quality as moderator of the three bonding DVs
quality_moderation <- map_dfr(c("psr_total", "ec_total", "trust_total"), function(dv) {
  bind_rows(
    {
      m1 <- lm(as.formula(glue::glue("{dv} ~ condition_label * tipi_within_sd")),
               data = df_primary)
      td <- broom::tidy(m1, conf.int = TRUE)
      row <- td[td$term == "condition_labelHighA:tipi_within_sd", , drop = FALSE]
      tibble(
        dv = dv, dv_label = unname(dv_labels[dv]),
        moderator = "TIPI within-person SD",
        b = if (nrow(row) > 0) row$estimate else NA_real_,
        p = if (nrow(row) > 0) row$p.value else NA_real_
      )
    },
    {
      m2 <- lm(as.formula(glue::glue("{dv} ~ condition_label * tipi_mahal")),
               data = df_primary)
      td <- broom::tidy(m2, conf.int = TRUE)
      row <- td[td$term == "condition_labelHighA:tipi_mahal", , drop = FALSE]
      tibble(
        dv = dv, dv_label = unname(dv_labels[dv]),
        moderator = "Mahalanobis distance",
        b = if (nrow(row) > 0) row$estimate else NA_real_,
        p = if (nrow(row) > 0) row$p.value else NA_real_
      )
    }
  )
})

quality_moderation %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 4)),
         p = fmt_p(p)) %>%
  kbl(caption = "Response quality as moderator of bonding effects") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = FALSE)

# (d) Sensitivity exclusion: high-quality only (within-SD > 0.5 AND Mahalanobis ≤ chi2 cutoff)
high_quality_threshold_mahal <- qchisq(0.999, df = 10)
df_high_quality <- df_primary %>%
  filter(!is.na(tipi_within_sd), tipi_within_sd >= 0.5,
         !is.na(tipi_mahal),     tipi_mahal <= high_quality_threshold_mahal)

cat(glue::glue(
  "\nHigh-quality sensitivity sample: N = {nrow(df_high_quality)} ",
  "(excluded {nrow(df_primary) - nrow(df_high_quality)} on response-quality grounds).\n"
))

if (nrow(df_high_quality) >= 30) {
  hq_results <- map_dfr(c("psr_total", "ec_total", "trust_total"),
                        ~welch_full(df_high_quality, .x))
  hq_results %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3)),
           p = fmt_p(p), bf10 = fmt_bf(bf10),
           dv_label = unname(dv_labels[dv])) %>%
    select(dv_label, n_ref, n_comp, t, df, p, d, d_lo, d_hi, bf10) %>%
    kbl(caption = glue::glue(
          "High-quality sensitivity sample (N = {nrow(df_high_quality)}): bonding DVs")) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)
  save_table(hq_results, "19_high_quality_sensitivity")
}

save_table(quality_moderation, "19b_quality_as_moderator")
```

## 12.9 High-engagement sensitivity sample (Prereg §7.7)

Prereg §7.7 specifies three sensitivity samples: (a) the full sample (no participant exclusions other than incomplete sessions and pilot), already reported in §6.2 as `df_sensitivity`; (b) the high-engagement sample (≥ 12 messages); (c) the clean sample (no contamination flag, no AI-tool self-report). The high-engagement subset is computed below; the clean sample collapses to the primary analytic sample because the relevant exclusions are already applied at the participant-level.

```{r high-engagement-sensitivity}
# chat_total_rounds is the prereg's "≥ 12 messages" criterion (rounds = paired turns)
# We use ≥ 12 user messages (i.e., chat_total_rounds ≥ 12) as the criterion
df_high_engagement <- df_primary %>% filter(chat_total_rounds >= 12)

cat(glue::glue(
  "High-engagement sensitivity sample: N = {nrow(df_high_engagement)} ",
  "({sum(df_high_engagement$condition_label == 'HighA')} HighA / ",
  "{sum(df_high_engagement$condition_label == 'LowA')} LowA). ",
  "Excluded {nrow(df_primary) - nrow(df_high_engagement)} participants with < 12 chat rounds.\n"
))

if (nrow(df_high_engagement) >= 30) {
  he_results <- map_dfr(confirmatory_dvs, ~welch_full(df_high_engagement, .x)) %>%
    mutate(dv_label = unname(dv_labels[dv]),
           q_bh = p.adjust(p, method = "BH"))

  # Side-by-side comparison with the primary
  he_compare <- bind_rows(
    results_primary %>% mutate(sample = "Primary (all)") %>%
      select(dv_label, sample, t, p, q_bh, d, bf10),
    he_results %>% mutate(sample = "High-engagement (≥ 12 rounds)") %>%
      select(dv_label, sample, t, p, q_bh, d, bf10)
  ) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = sample, values_from = c(t, p, q_bh, d, bf10),
                names_glue = "{sample}_{.value}")

  he_compare %>%
    mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3)),
           across(matches("(p|q_bh)$"), fmt_p),
           across(matches("bf10$"), fmt_bf)) %>%
    kbl(caption = glue::glue(
          "Primary vs. high-engagement sensitivity (N_high-engagement = {nrow(df_high_engagement)})"),
        booktabs = TRUE) %>%
    kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)

  save_table(he_results, "20_high_engagement_results")
  save_table(he_compare, "20b_primary_vs_high_engagement")
}
```

## 13.1 Robustness check: imbalanced covariates

The randomization check above flags any covariate where the conditions diverge at p < .05. When such an imbalance appears, we refit each confirmed bonding DV controlling for the imbalanced covariate to verify that the condition effect survives. We also include enrollment-order (`cb_slot`) as a covariate, as a routine check for drift over the recruitment window (final-sample enrollment-order correlations from §12.4: PSR *r* = `r sprintf("%.2f", enrollment_corr$r[enrollment_corr$dv == "psr_total"])`, *p* = `r fmt_p(enrollment_corr$p[enrollment_corr$dv == "psr_total"])`; EC *r* = `r sprintf("%.2f", enrollment_corr$r[enrollment_corr$dv == "ec_total"])`, *p* = `r fmt_p(enrollment_corr$p[enrollment_corr$dv == "ec_total"])`). <!-- FIX 2026-09-30 (C5): replaced stale "hovered near p ≈ .05 across recent knits" with live values -->

```{r balance-sensitivity}
# Identify imbalanced covariates (p < .05) from the table above.
# Use dplyr::filter explicitly to avoid any masking surprises from later-loaded packages.
imbalanced <- balance_table %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(p), p < 0.05) %>%
  dplyr::pull(variable)

# Always include enrollment-order in the sensitivity model (separate concern from balance).
# These two checks are reported together for compactness.

bonding_dvs_for_sensitivity <- c("psr_total", "ec_total", "trust_total")

# Map balance-table variable names to the actual data column names
balance_var_map <- c(
  age = "d_age_clean",
  phq4 = "phq4_total",
  gaais_pos = "gaais_pos",
  gaais_neg = "gaais_neg",
  tipi_self_agree = "tipi_self_agree"
)

if (length(imbalanced) > 0) {
  imbalanced_cols <- unname(balance_var_map[imbalanced])
  cat(glue::glue(
    "Imbalanced covariate(s) flagged: {paste(imbalanced, collapse = ', ')}. ",
    "Refitting bonding DVs with these as covariates plus enrollment-order (cb_slot).\n\n"
  ))
} else {
  imbalanced_cols <- character(0)
  cat("No covariates flagged as imbalanced at p < .05. Sensitivity model still includes ",
      "enrollment-order (cb_slot) as a routine robustness check.\n\n", sep = "")
}

# Build the sensitivity model formula
covariate_terms <- c(imbalanced_cols, "cb_slot")
covariate_terms <- covariate_terms[!is.na(covariate_terms) & nzchar(covariate_terms)]
covariate_str <- paste(covariate_terms, collapse = " + ")

# Helper: pull a single coefficient row safely. If the term isn't in the model
# (e.g., a covariate dropped due to collinearity), return NA-filled placeholders
# rather than crashing the whole pipeline.
extract_coef <- function(model, term_name) {
  td <- broom::tidy(model, conf.int = TRUE)
  row <- td[td$term == term_name, , drop = FALSE]
  if (nrow(row) == 0) {
    return(list(estimate = NA_real_, std.error = NA_real_, p.value = NA_real_,
                conf.low = NA_real_, conf.high = NA_real_))
  }
  list(
    estimate  = row$estimate[1],
    std.error = row$std.error[1],
    p.value   = row$p.value[1],
    conf.low  = row$conf.low[1],
    conf.high = row$conf.high[1]
  )
}

sensitivity_results <- purrr::map_dfr(bonding_dvs_for_sensitivity, function(dv) {
  raw_f <- as.formula(glue::glue("{dv} ~ condition_label"))
  m_raw <- lm(raw_f, data = df_primary)
  raw_coef <- extract_coef(m_raw, "condition_labelHighA")

  adj_f <- as.formula(glue::glue("{dv} ~ condition_label + {covariate_str}"))
  m_adj <- lm(adj_f, data = df_primary)
  adj_coef <- extract_coef(m_adj, "condition_labelHighA")

  # Pre-extract every scalar BEFORE the tibble() call, so the data-masking
  # in tibble() can't shadow `raw_coef` / `adj_coef`. (A previous version
  # named these locals `raw_b` / `adj_b`, which collided with the column
  # names below — tibble() rebinds the name after each `=`, so the next
  # `raw_b$std.error` saw an atomic and crashed.)
  raw_b_val  <- raw_coef$estimate
  raw_se_val <- raw_coef$std.error
  raw_p_val  <- raw_coef$p.value
  raw_lo_val <- raw_coef$conf.low
  raw_hi_val <- raw_coef$conf.high
  adj_b_val  <- adj_coef$estimate
  adj_se_val <- adj_coef$std.error
  adj_p_val  <- adj_coef$p.value
  adj_lo_val <- adj_coef$conf.low
  adj_hi_val <- adj_coef$conf.high

  pct_change <- if (!is.na(raw_b_val) && !is.na(adj_b_val) && raw_b_val != 0) {
    (adj_b_val - raw_b_val) / raw_b_val * 100
  } else NA_real_

  tibble::tibble(
    dv           = dv,
    dv_label     = unname(dv_labels[dv]),
    raw_b        = raw_b_val,
    raw_se       = raw_se_val,
    raw_p        = raw_p_val,
    raw_lo       = raw_lo_val,
    raw_hi       = raw_hi_val,
    adj_b        = adj_b_val,
    adj_se       = adj_se_val,
    adj_p        = adj_p_val,
    adj_lo       = adj_lo_val,
    adj_hi       = adj_hi_val,
    pct_change_b = pct_change,
    survives     = !is.na(adj_p_val) && adj_p_val < 0.05
  )
})

sensitivity_results %>%
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), ~round(., 3)),
         raw_p = fmt_p(raw_p), adj_p = fmt_p(adj_p),
         survives = ifelse(survives, "✓", "✗")) %>%
  kbl(caption = glue::glue(
        "Bonding DVs: raw vs. covariate-adjusted condition effects ",
        "(adjusting for: {covariate_str})")) %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), full_width = TRUE)

# Live verdict for the manuscript
n_survive <- sum(sensitivity_results$adj_p < 0.05, na.rm = TRUE)
n_total_sens <- nrow(sensitivity_results)
max_pct_change <- suppressWarnings(max(abs(sensitivity_results$pct_change_b), na.rm = TRUE))

cat(glue::glue(
  "\n--- Sensitivity verdict ---\n",
  "{n_survive}/{n_total_sens} bonding DVs retain p < .05 after adjusting for ",
  "{covariate_str}. Maximum absolute change in condition coefficient: ",
  "{ifelse(is.finite(max_pct_change), sprintf('%.1f%%', max_pct_change), 'NA')}.\n"
))

if (n_survive == n_total_sens) {
  cat("All bonding effects survive. The headline bonding finding is not driven by the imbalanced covariate(s) or by enrollment-order drift.\n")
} else if (n_survive == 0) {
  cat("None of the bonding effects survive adjustment. The headline bonding finding may be confounded by the imbalanced covariate(s) and/or enrollment-order drift. Inspect individual rows.\n")
} else {
  cat(glue::glue(
    "Mixed pattern: {n_survive}/{n_total_sens} bonding DVs survive. The DVs that no longer reach p < .05 after adjustment should be flagged in the manuscript with a sensitivity-driven caveat.\n"
  ))
}

save_table(sensitivity_results, "18b_balance_sensitivity")
```

# 14. Synthesis of All Findings

This is the wrap-up table. Every value pulls live from objects fit earlier in the notebook (`results_primary`, `M1`, `M3`, `m_tipi_ma`, `ss_tipi`, `m_legal`, `verbosity_adjusted_results`, `moderator_results`). Re-knitting at any sample size reproduces a current snapshot of the eight findings without any hard-coded numbers.

```{r key-findings-summary}
# Pull live values for each DV

# Format helpers

fmt_bf_str <- function(bf) {
  if (bf >= 100) sprintf("BF10 = %.0f", bf)
  else if (bf >= 10) sprintf("BF10 = %.1f", bf)
  else if (bf >= 1) sprintf("BF10 = %.2f", bf)
  else sprintf("BF10 = 1/%.1f", 1/bf)
}

# Build synthesis table

# FIX 2026-09-30 (C5): live helpers — every evidence class below is read from the joint
# TOST x Bayes table (tost_x_bf); nothing is hard-coded.  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
cls_of   <- function(lbl) tost_x_bf$null_evidence[tost_x_bf$dv_label == lbl]              # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
cls_list <- function(cl) {                                                                  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
  x <- tost_x_bf$dv_label[tost_x_bf$null_evidence == cl]  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)

}  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)

                "Evidence of presence", "Inconclusive")                                     # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
finding2_txt <- paste(map_chr(ev_classes, ~ glue::glue("{.x}: {cls_list(.x)}")),  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
                      collapse = "; ")                                                      # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
liab_lbls <- unname(dv_labels[c("liab_corp", "liab_chat", "liab_user", "liab_harm")])      # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)

          l, r$smd, r$smd_lo90, r$smd_hi90, r$tost_p_max,  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
          fmt_bf_str(get_dv(dvn, "bf10")), r$null_evidence)  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
}), collapse = "; ")  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)

# Helper for §5 mind-perception split label/text
ma_d   <- get_dv("ma_total", "d");   ma_bf <- get_dv("ma_total", "bf10")
mp_d   <- get_dv("mp_total", "d");   mp_bf <- get_dv("mp_total", "bf10")
# FIX 2026-09-30 (C5): MP/MA labels are now fully data-driven. The old MA label put a fixed
# "directional" prefix on every branch (e.g. "directional, moderate evidence for null"), and  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
# the old MP label fell through to "inconclusive" even if BF10 >= 3. Direction is now  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
# reported only when BF10 >= 3, from the sign of d (comp = HighA, ref = LowA).  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
bf_evidence_label <- function(bf, d, hi_lbl, lo_lbl) {                                     # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
  if (is.na(bf)) return("Bayes factor not computed")                                        # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
  dir_txt <- sprintf("%s %s %s", hi_lbl, ifelse(d > 0, ">", "<"), lo_lbl)                   # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
  if (bf >= 10)  return(sprintf("strong evidence for an effect (BF10 >= 10; %s)", dir_txt))    # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
  if (bf >= 3)   return(sprintf("moderate evidence for an effect (BF10 >= 3; %s)", dir_txt))   # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
  if (bf > 1)    return("anecdotal evidence for an effect")                                 # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
  if (bf < 1/10) return("strong evidence for the null")                                     # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
  if (bf < 1/3)  return("moderate evidence for the null")                                   # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
  if (bf < 1)    return("anecdotal evidence for the null")                                  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
  "inconclusive"                                                                            # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
}                                                                                          # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
```

```{r synthesis-prose, results='asis'}
  paste0("The personality-matching probe (TIPI-Self ", pm_trait_lbl, " × condition) does not reach ",  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
         "p < .05 on any of the ten DVs (smallest p = ", sprintf("%.3f", pm_top_row$interaction_p),  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
         ", ", pm_top_row$dv_label, "). We retain the analysis for transparency but do not treat it ",  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
         "as a substantive finding.")  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
}

# FIX 2026-09-30 (C5): takeaway from the live confirmation flags (q_BH < .05 AND BF10 >= 3)
bond_rows <- results_primary %>% filter(dv %in% c("psr_total", "ec_total", "trust_total"))           # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
liab_rows <- results_primary %>% filter(dv %in% c("liab_corp", "liab_chat", "liab_user", "liab_harm"))  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
n_bond_moved <- sum(bond_rows$confirmed, na.rm = TRUE)                                                # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
n_liab_moved <- sum(liab_rows$confirmed, na.rm = TRUE)                                                # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
liab_cls_txt <- paste(sprintf("%s: %s", liab_lbls, map_chr(liab_lbls, cls_of)), collapse = "; ")     # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)

takeaway <- if (n_bond_moved > 0 && n_liab_moved == 0) {                                    # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
  paste0("The dominant pattern is a **bonding-vs-liability dissociation**: ", n_bond_moved,  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
         "/3 bonding measures (", paste(bond_rows$dv_label[bond_rows$confirmed], collapse = ", "),  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
         ") meet the confirmation rule (q_BH < .05 and BF10 ≥ 3), while none of the four liability ",  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
         "measures does (joint TOST × Bayes classes — ", liab_cls_txt, "). ")  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
} else if (n_bond_moved == 0 && n_liab_moved == 0) {  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
  paste0("None of the bonding measures (PSR, EC, Trust) and none of the liability measures meets the ",  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
         "confirmation rule (q_BH < .05 and BF10 ≥ 3); liability joint TOST × Bayes classes — ",  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
         liab_cls_txt, ". ")  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
} else {  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
  paste0("The downstream pattern is mixed (", n_bond_moved, "/3 bonding and ", n_liab_moved,  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
         "/4 liability measures meet the confirmation rule, q_BH < .05 and BF10 ≥ 3); see the ",  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
         "synthesis table and §6 for per-DV detail. ")  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
}  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)

# FIX 2026-09-30 (C5): mediation sentence from live CI flags (M1 parallel, M3 serial)
ci_excl_lbl <- function(params, lbl) {                                                      # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
  r <- params %>% filter(label == lbl); isTRUE(r$ci.lower * r$ci.upper > 0)  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
}  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
m1_excl <- c(PSR = ci_excl_lbl(M1$params, "ind_psr"), EC = ci_excl_lbl(M1$params, "ind_ec"),  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
             Trust = ci_excl_lbl(M1$params, "ind_trust"))                                   # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
m3_excl <- ci_excl_lbl(M3$params, "ind_serial")                                             # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
med_txt <- if (!any(m1_excl) && !m3_excl) {                                                 # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
  paste0("Mediation analyses do not reveal credible indirect paths from condition through bonding ",  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
         "to Corporate Liability: none of the M1 indirect effects (via PSR, EC, or Trust) and not the ",  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
         "serial PSR → Moral Patiency → Corporate Liability path (M3) has a 95% bootstrap CI excluding ",  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
         "zero; ", n_b_sig, "/3 bonding → Corporate Liability b-paths in M1 reach p < .05. ")  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
} else {  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
  paste0("Mediation: indirect path(s) with a 95% bootstrap CI excluding zero — ",  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
         paste(c(if (any(m1_excl)) paste0("M1 via ", names(m1_excl)[m1_excl]),  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
                 if (m3_excl) "M3 serial PSR → Moral Patiency → Corporate Liability"),  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
               collapse = "; "), " (see §12.2). ")  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
}  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)

cat(takeaway,                                                                               # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
    med_txt,  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
    pm_strength,
    " These results and the open-ended responses from participants motivate the NLP analyses to follow.\n",  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
    sep = "")  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C5)
```

# 15. Save Processed Data for Downstream Notebooks

```{r save-processed}
# Composite scores file (one row per participant, scale composites + key covariates)
composite_scores <- df_primary %>%
  select(
    sona_id, condition_label, cb_slot,
    # TIPI-Self
    starts_with("tipi_self_") & matches("(extra|agree|consc|emostab|open)$"),
    # TIPI-Bot
    starts_with("tipi_bot_") & matches("(extra|agree|consc|emostab|open)$"),
    # MC items
    starts_with("mc_"),
    # Composites
    psr_total, psr_connection, psr_desire, psr_caring,
    ec_total, trust_total, et_total, ma_total, mp_total,
    liab_corp, liab_chat, liab_user, liab_harm,
    phq4_total, phq4_anx, phq4_dep,
    gaais_pos, gaais_neg,
    # Behavioral
    chat_total_rounds, chat_idle_pause_count,
    bot_tokens_per_turn, bot_chars_per_turn,
    user_chars_per_turn, user_total_chars,
    # Moderators / covariates
    legal_expertise, legal_training_law, jury_yes,
    free_speech_avg, d_chatbot_experience, d_age, d_politics,
    d_religiosity, d_education, d_gender, d_race,  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C2)
    d_age_mod, d_politics_mod, d_religiosity_mod  # FIX 2026-09-30 (C2): added cleaned moderator versions (raw columns kept)
  )
write_csv(composite_scores, here("data", "processed", "composite_scores.csv"))

# Full analytic dataset
analytic_data <- df_primary
write_csv(analytic_data, here("data", "processed", "analytic_data.csv"))

# Item-level long-form (for NLP notebook integration)
item_level_long <- df_primary %>%
  select(sona_id, condition_label,
         starts_with("psr_") & matches("^psr_\\d+$"),
         starts_with("ec_") & matches("^ec_\\d+$"),
         starts_with("tr_") & matches("^tr_\\d+$"),
         starts_with("et_") & matches("^et_\\d+$"),
         starts_with("ma_") & matches("^ma_\\d+$"),
         starts_with("mp_") & matches("^mp_\\d+$"),
         starts_with("liab_") & matches("^liab_\\d+$")) %>%
  pivot_longer(-c(sona_id, condition_label), names_to = "item", values_to = "response")
write_csv(item_level_long, here("data", "processed", "item_level_long.csv"))

# Open-ended responses for the NLP notebook
oe_data <- df_primary %>%
  select(sona_id, condition_label, cb_slot,
         oe_experience, oe_person_or_tool, oe_responsibility, oe_compensation,
         d_final_thoughts, d_problems, chat_log)
write_csv(oe_data, here("data", "processed", "oe_and_chat.csv"))

cat("Saved:\n")
cat(glue("  data/processed/composite_scores.csv ({nrow(composite_scores)} × {ncol(composite_scores)})\n"))
cat(glue("  data/processed/analytic_data.csv ({nrow(analytic_data)} columns minus list-cols)\n"))
cat(glue("  data/processed/item_level_long.csv ({nrow(item_level_long)} item-rows)\n"))
cat(glue("  data/processed/oe_and_chat.csv ({nrow(oe_data)} × {ncol(oe_data)})\n"))
```
